title: Maps
body:
An [[Abstract Data Type]] storing key-value pairs, with keys unique: `put(key, value)`,
`get(key)`, `remove(key)`. Also called a dictionary or associative array.

Map is the *interface*, not the implementation. A [[Hash Map]] implements it with [[Hashing]]
for $O(1)$ average lookup and no ordering; a tree map implements it with a
[[Balanced Tree]] for $O(\log n)$ lookup and keys held in sorted order. In [[Java]] those are
`HashMap` and `TreeMap`, both implementing the `Map` interface, which is the ADT-versus-
structure distinction made concrete.
